answer: Therefore, each alias costs 10 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the jetty record reveals exactly who is still on probation. Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the ledge queue naming the knoll that holds the sponsor's bond. A new identity serves a probation of 10 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. That is 37 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
